query: Which game was released first, Icehouse pieces or Kill Doctor Lucky?

pipeline_result.response: Based on the information provided, it is unclear which game was released first, Icehouse pieces or Kill Doctor Lucky. The game Icehouse pieces was released in 1985 and was released as a single-player game by the company, Icehouse. In contrast, Kill Doctor Lucky was released in 2003 and was released on two discs, one of which was a single-player game.
